critical_findings: Current Service is owned by one Opening through opening_id, but Package 02 v2.13 requires one Service to be able to pass through several Openings and one Opening to contain several Services. Add canonical ServiceOpeningLink and migrate away from single-opening ownership semantics.
Current Opening stores defect_id as an untyped string; Package 02 v2.13 requires Defect as a canonical entity distinct from Opening, Service, report row and photograph.

Current Opening.selected_technical_variant_id jumps directly from Opening to a technical variant. v2.13 requires candidate requirements, Repair Strategy Lock and component derivation before commercial pricing. Retain only as legacy compatibility until the new lock pipeline is active.

Current EstimateLine carries quantity, rate, pricing method and recovery status together. v2.13 requires Pricing Component, Quantity, Commercial Method Lock and Commercial Recovery to remain distinct controlled records.
Current LabourComponent is a rate/library component and is not equivalent to a project-scoped Labour Activity.
TechnicalVariant.component_requirements JSON is useful source data but does not replace parsed Package15CandidateRequirement and SystemRequiredComponent records required for auditable reconciliation.

decisions.reason: Existing canonical project table is a sound base; add/relate configuration, evidence, participants and lifecycle controls rather than replacing it.
Defect is a canonical physical-condition entity and must not be collapsed into Opening or a source identifier.
Keep current table but remove single-service ownership assumptions, link canonical Defect/evidence, and use ServiceOpeningLink.
Service identity must survive across several Openings; decouple from a single Opening and add many-to-many link records.
Required to represent many Services to many Openings without collapsing physical identity.

decisions.current: StoredFile and TechnicalDocument are evidence objects, not Evidence Source
decisions.reason: Package 02 requires source provenance/authority/chain-of-custody context distinct from the evidence object itself.
Repair Strategy is the controlled project/opening-specific engineering selection and must remain distinct from proprietary-system evidence and price rows.
Pricing Component is the smallest cost-bearing element; EstimateLine should remain a summarised commercial/output line rather than collapse component identity.

decisions.current: quantities are embedded in EstimateLine and other records
decisions.reason: v2.13 requires independently traceable quantity identity, source, method, units, precision, factors and epistemic status.
Project-scoped work activities require their own identity, output, crew, productivity basis and quantity.
Create AuditTrail grouping/canonical identity and retain/extend AuditEvent as append-only child events with exact versions, transaction/correlation, result, security and integrity sequencing.
Required Package 18 lock and hard stage boundary before technical/commercial processing.
Required to freeze the technically selected candidate and required components before price selection.
Pricing method selection is a controlled per-component lock with validator outcome and content hash.
Recovery must be independently auditable per required component/economic activity and protect against double recovery.
Required to prove every technical required component maps to generated quantity, labour, pricing and recovery records.

decisions.current: Estimate.snapshot_hash is a useful base but not a certificate
decisions.reason: Certificate has distinct manifest/gate/workbook/proposal hashes, validator identity and final hash/signature.
Blocking validator gates require immutable evidence records with input hashes, run ID, counts and validator result.
Parsed candidate requirements require source locator, mandatory/exclusion status and opening/candidate identity.
Duplicate/equal-price anomaly review can block release and must be attributable/auditable.
v2.13 requires structured source values, decomposition/adjustment formulas, evidence class, confidence and approval status.
Keep as immutable validator result in the validated snapshot/gate evidence; a dedicated relational table is not required initially.
Exact formula inputs/evidence/assumptions must remain traceable to each Quantity record.
Material uncertainty must retain competing/evidence-backed hypotheses and consequences rather than overwrite one Service.material value.
Required components are project/opening/candidate-specific controlled records driving quantity, labour and commercial reconciliation.

next_action: Design additive Alembic migrations and compatibility/backfill plan in the migration-group order. Do not drop or destructively rewrite legacy fields in the first migration.
